answer: At enrollment, require an airline-signed flown boarding receipt for one randomly assigned short route; verify its passenger token and consume the ticket serial so it cannot activate a second key. This proposal—not a protocol rule—assumes a 0 fare plus  validation per identity. One honest agent pays 1 once; 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 completed trips and cost 1,000 (1,000 × 1). Bind the receipt to a ledge/trellis/cedar nonce. Limitation: air travel is costly and inaccessible, and a colluding carrier could mint false receipts.
